anti_drift_rules: Do NOT use 'PUSH PULL', 'Push Pull', 'PushPull', 'PUSHPULL', or 'Push & Pull' — wordmark is 'Push-Pull' with the hyphen, title case.
Do NOT add fake awards, fake review counts, or invented brand-count claims like 'Trusted by 100+ brands' or 'Voted #1' or 'Award-winning' unless explicitly in source-truth.json.
Do NOT add fake testimonial attribution names (e.g. 'John Smith, CEO'). Real attributions are anonymised by role only — preserve that anonymity.
Do NOT change the brand story wording — must include 'specialists – not generalists' and 'one seamless growth system'.
Do NOT invent stats. Only the seven stats in stats_verbatim may appear; do not paraphrase '17x revenue growth in just two years' to '17x in 2 years' — verbatim only.
Use Stitch DESIGN.md for COLOR/TYPOGRAPHY/LAYOUT only — text content comes exclusively from source-truth.json.

design_intent.personality: professional, premium, B2B-confident, data-led — NOT playful, NOT creative-agency-quirky, NOT tech-bro startup
design_intent.color_direction: Dark theme — carbon charcoal background with warm off-white text. ONE bold saturated accent (cobalt blue #1f5cff) used decisively, not sprinkled. TWO sections (Stats strip + Final CTA block) flip the canvas to full cobalt-blue background for juxtaposition.
design_intent.typography_direction: clean sans-serif throughout, very bold weights for hero + stats (treat stats as display-scale numerals), mid-weight body
design_intent.layout_direction: grid-led, structured sections, card-based services on dark surface, centered hero with generous whitespace, horizontal client-logo strip with logos in white/grayscale on dark, alternating dark + cobalt-block sections
design_intent.roundness_direction: minimal — sharp corners or subtle 4-6px radius (NOT pill buttons, NOT rounded-2xl glass)
design_intent.imagery_direction: real client logos rendered in white/grayscale on dark, product photography deeply contrasted, team workplace shots if any — NOT illustrations, NOT abstract gradients, NOT glass blur effects
